messages:
zoe (Partnerships): Vendor ping: some H100 slots in eu-central are degrading under long-context inference. They propose a short embargo if we surface a public advisory. Can we put a quiet mitigation in place first?

ben (Ops): What's the impact window and which customers? I can flip routing rules if we agree.

vijay (Partner Eng): Vendor says affected units show thermal warnings after ~3 hours of sustained 30k+ token sessions. They offered a firmware patch but needs rack reboot.

chen (Runtime): Short mitigation: throttle H100 burst on marketplace routes and route excess to H200/mi300-compatible variants. Will require a router rule and sticky-session handling.

maya (SRE): I'll add alerts for GPU temp > 84C sustained 5m and rack_reboot_count >2 in 1h. Also prepare a canary plan for 4 racks.

ben (Ops): Proposed router change (summary): soft-cap h100 -> 70%, fallbacks [h200, mi300-eu], sticky 45s. I can apply as a feature-flag rollout.

chen (Runtime): I'll prep the runtime PR with unit tests for sticky behavior and fallback billing tag. ETA 25m.

vijay (Partner Eng): I'll ask vendor for ETA on patch and whether they need an embargo for joint messaging. Early word: they prefer quiet patching.

zoe (Partnerships): Good. Owners: Chen PR, Maya alerts + canary, Ben apply flag, Vijay vendor ETA, me for customer comms if required. If vendor asks for embargo, escalate to legal/marketing.

notif-bot: reminder: post status to #eng-oncall after mitigation is live.

ben (Ops): Applying feature-flag now in staging; will promote to prod after tests pass.

chen (Runtime): PR opened: runtime/h100-fallbacks (#621). Request review from @maya and @ben.

zoe (Partnerships): Thanks team — reconvene if vendor asks for joint press or if alerts fire.
